turns.question: How many distinct customers bought from us on 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: 9 active customers (distinct customers with at least one non-cancelled order) bought from us on 2 October 2026, a one-day period (2026-10-02). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
